description.narrative: The indicator is the ratio of the total electricity generated (measured at the power plants/station) from fuel oil divided by the total volume of fuel oil used multiplied by 100. The indicator is specifically for the power stations based in Tongatapu, Vavau and Haapai. The total electricity generated and fuel oil consumed will be a cumulative of the 3 power plants
